Commentary.Commentary: Once again, the hosts' bowlers have come up with an impressive show. Now, all eyes will be on their batsman. Can they rise to the occasion to keep the series alive? Or will the in-form trio of Rashid, Nabi and Mujeeb make a match out of this? Expect a hard-fought chase. Join us on the other side of the break.

The Irish bowlers, with some tight and tidy bowling, kept the Afghan batters under check throughout the innings. With some impressive fielding efforts (two run outs and a stumping), tight lines and lengths and some intelligent changes of pace, the Afghanistan innings just could not take off at any stage.

However, once Shah departed, things once again got gloomy for them. Afghan's unfortunate run out added to their woes. But, Najibullah Zadran, with support from the tail, managed to put up a fighting total on the board.

Losing four wickets inside the first ten overs, Ireland put the Afghanistan batsmen on the back foot right from the word go. Tim Murtagh, in his opening spell, broke the spine of the tourists' top order. Afghanistan were 16 for 4 before a 56-run partnership between Rahmat Shah and his skipper saw them pull back things a bit and bring their rail on track.

Some responsible batting by the Afghanistan middle and lower order along with a small surge at the end has meant that the visitors have reached a fighting total of 182. After winning the toss and electing to bat, the visiting team were off to a horrid start.
Full ball on middle and leg, Rahman hits it down to long on and comes back for a couple. AFGHANISTAN FINISH ON 182/9!
Slower bouncer, Mujeeb swings but misses.
Fuller length ball, Rahman shapes to play the reverse hit again and O'Brien bowls it down the leg side. He fails to connect.

FOUR! Keeps it full around off, Rahman is in position way before the ball is released by the bowler. He goes for the reverse scoop and gets it bang on. The ball flies over the short third man fielder and an important boundary this for Afghanistan.
Alam pulls this short of a length ball on the stumps, gets a single to deep square leg.
Wide of off stump, cut towards the point region.

FOUR! Third time lucky. Rahman gets the pull out on this short of a length delivery outside off. This time the ball finds the middle of Rahman's bat. The ball races across the deep mid-wicket boundary.
Similar ball, similar attempt by Rahman and the same result. Another dot ball.
Beaten! Slower off cutter on a length just outside off, Rahman goes for the wild swing and misses the ball. Niall O'Brien behind tidies things well.
Fuller and straighter on the stumps, driven to mid on for a single.
Alam wants to have a whack at everything now. He goes for a wild swing to this length ball around off, hopes to get it over the cow corner boundary. But gets beaten by pace and misses it completely.
Fuller delivery just outside off, stroked away to deep point for a single.
Hangs back to the length ball and keeps it out.

Confusion but safe! Full ball on leg stump, Alam tries to flick it away but the ball lobs off the pads towards covers. He sets off for a run but is sent back as his partner spots the point fielder rushing in. The throw comes in but it misses the target. Would have been close had that hit.

FOUR! Just over the man at short third man! Chase hits the deck hard as he lands this one on off. Alam backs away and upper cuts it. The fielder leaps but it just goes over him to the third man fence.
Alam tries to heave another length ball but once again only manages to connect with thin air.
Good length ball on leg stump, Alam makes space for himself as he tries to tonk it out of the park but misses.
Full ball on middle and leg, turned around the corner for a single.
Peter Chase is back for his final over.
Keeps it a bit short of a length, Alam pushes this one into the mid-wicket region but there's no single on offer.

Wild swing again but an inside edge onto the pads is the result. A length ball on off, Alam tries to go for a heave again, gets the inner part of the bat and the ball thuds into his pads. No chance of a run.

FOUR! Flat-bats it through the mid off region for four valuable runs for the visiting team. Kevin bowls this slower and just back of a length around off. Alam waits for it to arrive, and with a horizontal swing of the bat, gets the ball between the bowler and the mid off fielder. There is enough power in the shot to take the ball racing across the fence.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! An important wicket for the hosts in the context of the game. The dangerous southpaw could have done some damage in the end.  Keeps it a bit shorter this time. Zadran goes for the pull. The ball goes in the air and it seems like it will sail over the fielder again. But Simi Singh at the deep square leg boundary, backtracks, judges it perfectly and pouches it safely. A very smart and responsible innings from Zadran comes to an end.

SIX! First one of the innings. Monstorous hit by Zadran. Kevin O'Brien keeps this slower ball very full in line of the stumps. Zadran, with his weight behind the ball, swings through the line. He gets good elevation and the ball sails over the mid-wicket fence for a gigantic maximum.
Lands it just behind a length on the off stump. Aftab goes for the wild swing at the ball, manages to get some bat on the ball and it goes towards long on. A single taken.
Finishes the over well! Back of a length around off, Najibullah makes room, goes for the slap but only gets a bottom edge towards short third man.
Three dots in a row! Good thinking from Rankin. He is not allowing Zadran any space to work with. Bangs this one in the tight off stump corridor as Zadran can only tap it to point.
Beaten! Shortish ball and there is some room on offer, Zadran flashes his blade at it but only connects with thin air.
On a length, leaving the southpaw. He cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Similar length ball outside off, dabbed nicely to third man to rotate strike. Gives the strike back to Zadran and that is what is needed.
Good length ball on off, Najibullah makes room and glides it towards backward point. Calls his partner through for a brisk run.
Zadran drives this full ball on off to mid off. Takes a run and keeps strike.

FOUR! If you slash, slash hard. That's exactly what Zadran did as he saw the width on this back of a length delivery from Kevin O'Brien. The ball takes the thickish outside edge and flies over the slip region with pace on it. The man at third man has no chance of cutting it off and the visitors get an important boundary.
Beaten! Bowls it slower on a length outside off, the ball pitches and cuts away a bit, Zadran tries to put bat on ball but misses. Niall does better this time.
Kevin strays a bit down the leg side, Zadran gets inside the line and works it away on the leg side through the mid-wicket region. The batsman are sharp enough to run back for the second.
Zadran goes for the pull shot against this slower and shorter delivery on off, gets enough bat on it, the fielder at deep square leg keeps them down to two.

Bye! Kevin starts his new spell with a slower delivery outside the off stump. He rolls his fingers over the ball, Alam waits and waits for it to arrive, tries to put bat on ball but misses. Niall O'Brien behind messes it up as he does not collect it cleanly allowing the pair to run a bye.
Kevin O'Brien to have a burst again.
A back of a length ball is pushed to the cover fielder. No run on offer.
Alam flicks this straight delivery on middle and leg. The ball rolls over to the long leg fielder as they cross over for a single.
Marginally short of a length, Zadran opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man for a single.
Gives himself room and slashes hard at this short of a length ball outside off, gets a top edge and it flies to the left of the third man fielder who keeps it to just a run.
Alam sees this length ball angling into him, tries to work it down the leg side but does not connect. No run.
Shortish in length outside the off stump, Zadran pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Alam goes for the wild swing, mistimes his heave and the ball flies in the air but falls short of the mid off fielder. No run taken.
Defends this back of a length delivery back to the bowler.
Shorter this time by Murtagh, in line of the stumps. Zadran pulls it down to long leg for a single.
Short and a bit wide of off, Zadran plays the cut but finds the point fielder. No run there.
Fullish delivery on the stumps is driven uppishly towards the mid on region. Just a single though.
Murtagh goes short and Zadran does well to control the pull shot and plays it out to cow corner for a run.
Rankin angles this back of a length ball into Zadran, who flicks it to the square leg region for a single.
Wide! Bouncer, banged in too short. Wide given for height.
Defends this length ball into the cover region.

Dropped! The Irish captain would be disappointed with that. Rankin continues to keep it on a short of a length. Alam smashes the ball towards Porterfield at mid off. The ball is traveling and although he gets his hands to the ball, he is not able to hold on. A single results.
Length around off, Alam gets on the front foot and drives it to covers.
Alam backs away and thrusts the bat out at the ball, the man at backward point fields well to avoid the run.
Rankin starts off a new spell by keeping it on a length around off, Zadran comes forward and pushes it to the cover region for a single.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
On a length around off, kept out watchfully.
Back of a length outside off, cut away to backward point for a run.
Aftab Alam comes in to bat.

OUT! Back-to-back 4-wicket hauls for Tim Murtagh! He has been on song in the ODI series. A poor shot from Rashid Khan has brought about his downfall. Back of a length ball around off, Khan walks down the track and has a wild heave at it. However, he only manages a top edge that skies towards mid on. Kevin O'Brien stationed there backtracks a bit and pouches it safely. Seems like Afghanistan won't be able to survive their full quota of overs.
Good length ball around off, angling in. Khan tries to work it away but is hit high on the pads. A stifled appeal from Murtagh is turned down.
Back of a length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
FOUR! That was hit with authority! Shortish ball on middle, sits up nicely for Zadran. He stands tall and pulls it with aplomb through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary.
Time for Powerplay 3! Maximum of five fielders will now be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Chase keeps it on a length just on off stump. Khan comes forward and defends.

Chase continues to keep it a bit back of a length, Zadran goes back and tries to pull it. The ball goes off the inner half of the bat and rolls to the square leg region. The batsmen cross over for a single.
Chase keeps it a bit short of a length just outside off, Khan plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Short of a length on off,  pushed to the cover region. No run.
Flicks this length ball on middle towards the deep square leg region, results in a brace.

Chase bangs it a bit short in line of the stumps, Zadran plays the pull shot and gets this one over the mid-wicket fielder. The fielder at long leg runs across to his left and keeps it away from crossing the ropes. Three runs added to the total.
Fuller and straighter attacking the stumps, Khan attempts to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Fuller in length on the stumps but Khan can just push it to the cover region.
Pitches this just behind a length, Khan pushes this one to point but no run on offer.

FOUR! First boundary in ten overs, 58 balls to be precise. Afghanistan need more of these. Short of a length delivery outside off, it has been cut away by Khan through square of the wicket on the off side. The ball beats the diving point fielder and crosses the ropes.
A bit short of a length, punched to point but no run on offer.
Zadran pushes this short of a length ball on the stumps to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tim Murtagh returns. His figures read 6-1-10-3. He would be aiming to clean the tail up quickly.
Length ball angling in, flicked with the angle to the square leg region for a single.
Wide! Bouncer again, too high again, wide called for height.
On a length around off, Khan opens the bat face slightly and runs it towards the point region, they cross over for a run.
A fullish ball on off is driven to mid off. No run.
Wide! The attempted bouncer, goes well over Khan's head. The umpire signals a wide.
On a short of a length around off, punched straight to the fielder at covers.
On a length, just in the corridor. Khan blocks it with a straight bat.
Chase starts his new spell by landing it on a length outside off, Zadran stays inside the crease and throws his bat at it. The fielder at sweeper cover keeps it down to a single.
Peter Chase is back for a burst.
Zadran goes back to this slower delivery on middle and off, works it to the square leg region for a single.
Khan sweeps this full ball on off stump towards deep square leg, connects well but gets just a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball on off, Khan keeps it out.
Zadran goes for his favourite shot. Sees the tossed up ball on the stumps,  gets into position early and reverse sweeps that one to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Khan comes forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and fuller on the stumps, Zadran swings the bat hard but does not connect well, the ball goes to long on for a single.
Flighted and very full on the stumps, Zadran drives it hard but straight to the fielder at covers. No run.
Very slow and tossed up delivery, Afghan drills it down to long on for a single.
McBrine tosses this up on middle and leg, Zadran leans forward and drives it to the man at long off. They exchange strike.
Andy McBrine returns.
Loopy ball, knocked down to long on for a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Fuller in length, driven crisply to mid off.
Slow through the air, pushed to the cover region.
Tossed up around off, eased to mid off.
Rashid Khan is the new man in.

OUT! The Irishmen have been electric on the field and they are getting the rewards. Tossed up ball on off, Afghan works it towards the man at 45. Zadran calls him through for a single. The skipper is not that sure but he eventually responds to his partner's call. Paul Stirling runs in, picks up the ball cleanly and hits his target at the bowler's end with needle-like precision as Asghar tries hard to make his ground. The reaction from him suggests that he is a goner as he stares at Najibullah. It is taken upstairs. Well, the replays find him well short of where he needed to be. It is also seen that Afghan was trying to avoid running on the pitch as he moved a bit wide. He was warned by Ian Gould in the previous over for doing so. It would have been playing on in his mind. That also accounted for him being slow across the deck. Another one bites the dust.
Asghar Afghan seems to be a goner. Stirling has hit the bull's eye at the bowler's end and he is cock-a-hoop.
Angled in delivery by Rankin, just back of a length. Afghan turns it to the square leg region wristily and keeps strike. End of a tight over by Rankin.
Bumper! Afghan sees the bouncer early and sways away to let it through to the keeper.
Pushes this length delivery around off to the cover-point region. Afghan sets off for a run but he is rightly sent back. Umpire Ian Gould has a word with Asghar for running down the pitch.
Lands it on a short of a length in line of the stumps, Afghan keeps it out with a straight bat.
A bit shorter and tighter by Rankin around off, Afghan stays back in his crease and punches this to the cover fielder.
Rankin keeps it on a short of a length, Afghan gets behind the line of the ball and defends.
Zadran again tries the reverse sweep to this full delivery on off, does not get it off the middle and the ball rolls down to short third man. No run taken.

Singh tosses this on the stumps, Afghan has flicked the ball off his pads to the leg side. A direct hit by the fielder at square leg at the non-striker's end makes the umpire take the help of the third umpire. Replay shows he is in and NOT OUT is signalled. Afghan survives.
A bit flatter and straighter this time by Singh. Zadran works it down towards short fine leg for a single. With that, the left-hander completes 1000 runs in ODI cricket.
Flighted around the off stump, drives this one to mid off.
Beaten! Singh tosses this one outside off. Zadran tries to go for the reverse sweep and completely misses the ball. Niall O'Brien behind the stumps collects.
Tossed up around off, Afghan defends it on the leg side and runs through for a quick single.
Time for Drinks.
Similar length by Rankin, Zadran is out with a straight bat.
Shorter in length and on off, Zadran goes back and blocks it down.
Length ball around off is punched in the covers for a single.
Zadran punches this short of a length ball into the cover-point region. They take quick single.
Bit shorter in length, angling into the body of the batsman, Afghan gets up on his toes to work that one on the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short of a length delivery is defended off the back foot.
Boyd Rankin back on for a burst. This is a good move from Porterfield, he is going for the kill.
This straight tossed up ball is blocked out by Zadran.
Zadran comes forward and defends this full ball on the stumps.
Flighted ball around the off stump, punches it to the fielder at covers.
Tossed up on the stumps, blocked out.
Tossed up on the stumps, Afghan flicks the ball off his pads towards the square leg region. One run added to the total.
Afghan rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to covers. No run.
Lands it on a short of a length. Zadran keeps it away off the back foot. A successful over for Ireland.
Bumper! Zadran evades it by swaying away well.

Chase gets straighter by attacking the stumps. Afghan is well set and he flicks this angling in delivery to the deep square leg region. Finds the gap  but not the ropes as the fielder there cuts this one off and saves a run for his team.
Najibullah Zadran is the next man in.

OUT! The hosts continue to make merry. Nabi fails to make his 100th ODI a memorable one, at least with the bat. Chase bangs this one on a short of a length outside off. Nabi sees the width on this one and goes for the upper cut but does not control the shot properly. The ball flies towards the third man region where Kevin O'Brien is placed a bit square. He does really well to run to his left and takes a fine tumbling catch. The experienced campaigner is on his way back.
Straighter and fuller ball on the pads, Nabi tries to flick this one but misses and the ball hits his pads. There is no chance of a single.
Length ball around off, Afghan works it down the leg side. They have run through for a single.
Nabi has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length around off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Brings the broom out nicely. Nabi gets down on his knee and sweeps this full ball. His connection is superb as the ball finds the gap at the deep square leg boundary and it crosses the ropes.
Length ball around off, Afghan stays back and places it towards the square leg region for a single.
Beaten! Tossed up just outside off, Afghan comes forward to defend. The ball skids on and beats Afghan.
Nabi works this one with the spin towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
A bit short of a length, Nabi cuts and cuts well. The fielder at point runs behind and chases it down from crossing the ropes. They run three.
Some chin music for Nabi, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
On a length around off, Nabi opens the face and gets it past the diving point fielder. They cross over for a couple.
Similar ball outside off and Afghan with a better punch this time. The fielder at point runs back and keeps it down to a brace.
A bit on a shorter side outside off, Afghan punches this in the gap at the cover-point region and changes strike.
Starts the over with a length ball in the corridor, Afghan pushes it to the fielder at covers. No run there.
Peter Chase is back on.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Afghan goes back and punches it to the cover-point region for a single.
Nabi waits for the ball to arrive, works it with the spin towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, taps it towards the mid-wicket region.
Mohammad Nabi strides out to bat. He his playing his 100th ODI, having featured in all the games for Afghanistan so far in this format. Can he make this a memorable outing?

OUT! Yes, he has! That was super sharp from Niall O'Brien, great stuff. Singh slows this one as he tosses this one just outside off. Rahmat Shah comes forward to push at it. He is playing for the spin but the ball skids through straight. Shah loses his balance just for a split second and that much is enough for O'Brien to take the bails off in a jiffy. The square leg umpire has gone up to the TV umpire. The replays show that Shah's back foot is just short of the crease. Some smart bowling and keeping. The promising 56-run stand comes to an end. Afghanistan have lost half their side now and there are still more than 23 overs to play out.
A brilliant piece of glovework from Niall O'Brien and he is really confident regarding the stumping. Has he got the better of Rahmat Shah?
Flatter and fuller on off, Rahmat goes back and defends with the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on middle and off, Afghan gets his front foot across the line and works this one between square leg and the mid-wicket fielders for a single.
Simi Singh to roll his arm over now.
Straight ball on the pads, Asghar nicely flicks it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Splice-tickler! Rankin bangs this one in but Afghan has nothing to do with it as he ducks under it.
A bit short of a length, Afghan tries to cut it but the ball takes the inside half of the bat and trickles to the point fielder.
On a length around off, pushed to point. No run on offer.
A bit short and angled into the batsman's body, Afghan stays back in his crease and keeps it out.
A shortish delivery around off, Shah taps it towards the point region and they run a quick single.
Asghar Afghan is taking a bit of a breather as he sips on some water.
Fuller and attacking the stumps, Afghan flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket. No run.
O'Brien gets too straight, angles it into Afghan's body who works it down the leg side and they take a brace.
Fuller and straighter ball, works it towards mid-wicket for a single.

A bit short of a length just outside the off stump line. Afghan opens the face at the last moment and guides it towards short third man, they run through for a single. And the 50-run stand comes up. The tourists will want this one to extend further.
Keeps it tight on the stumps. Afghan gets out a perfect front foot defence.
Lands this one on a length around off. Afghan gets his front foot forward and pushes this to the mid-wicket region. No chance of a run.
Fuller and straighter. Shah shows the full face of the bat and defends.
Very full delivery angling into the stumps, Afghan flicks this to long leg for a single.
Marginally short of a length around off, tapped towards the point region.
Bouncer! Afghan ducks under the short ball at the last moment.
Similar delivery but Shah opens the face of the bat a bit more and beats the diving point fielder. They take a run.
Rankin starts his new spell with a back of a length delivery around off, the batsman stays in his crease and taps it to point. No run.
Boyd Rankin returns.
Good length ball outside off, Asghar taps it towards point. He wants a run but his partner denies it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tentative! On a length around off, jagging in. Afghan is late to bring his bat down but manages to get an inside edge onto his pads.
Angling down the leg side, tucked to the man at 45 for a single.
Rahmat shuffles a touch this time as this fullish ball is clipped towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat.
Kevin lands it on a tight off stump channel, Rahmat camps back and answers it with a straight bat.
Gives this one more revs and tosses it around off, Asghar is solid as a rock as he dead-bats it. Good over for Afghanistan, 8 from it. They need more of these. Need to keep the scoreboard ticking.
Shah leans ahead and drives this one with the spin to long on for a run.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fullish ball around off, good shot selection from Shah as he crouches and nails the sweep through backward square leg to find the fence.
Full loopy ball around off, Shah puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Waits for the ball to turn into him and places it nicely towards square leg to rotate strike.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Asghar tries to flick it away but misses.
Shorter in length, Rahmat rocks back and milks it down to long on for a single.
Right through the gate but his pads save him! Cutting in sharply after landing, Afghan tries to block it but gets hit on the pads.
Length outside off, tapped with soft hands towards point.
The batsman works it down the leg side.

A misfield! On a length outside off, Shah opens his bat face and drives it nicely towards backward point. The fielder dives to his right but the ball goes past him in a jiffy. Some work for the man in the deep and he saves a run for his side.
Fullish ball, shaping in, tucked nicely with a closed bat face through mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length outside off, played with an angled bat towards point.
Full ball attacking the stumps, Shah leans ahead and taps it back to the bowler.
Fractionally overpitched around off, kept out down the track.
Short ball in line of the stumps, Afghan rocks back and pulls it nicely over mid-wicket. Some aggressive running between the batsmen allows them to come back for a brace.
On a length on middle and leg, tucked to deep square leg to change strike.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

In the air... but safe! Tossed up around off, Afghan uses his feet and tries to go downtown but slices it off the outer half over covers. Chase in the deep makes a mess of it and ends up conceding a couple.

Is that a dropped catch? Yes, it is. Not easy though for a keeper standing up to the stumps to a medium pacer and getting hold of edges. On a length around off, skids after pitching. Afghan pushes at it with hard hands but gets a faint nick behind. Niall O'Brien tries to take it but it deflects off his hands towards short third man. A run taken.
Tight stump-to-stump line, kept out with a straight bat.
Full ball on the pads, tucked away nicely to deep square leg for a single.
Pitched up ball around off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.

Good fielding! Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Asghar is early into his flick and gets a leading edge. The fielder at short extra cover gets low and after collecting it, has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. An overthrow takes place but the attitude is good from the Irishmen. Their energy levels have been up throughout and they are giving it their all.
Good length ball around off, angling in, tapped towards point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A welcome boundary. More of these for the visitors. Asghar gets low to this tossed up delivery and sweeps this behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Stays on the back foot and defends it on the leg side.
Comes forward again and drives it to long on for one.
Gives this some loop and bowls it fuller, Shah comes forward and blocks it out.
Straighter one from McBrine, Rahmat goes back and keeps it out safely.
Andy McBrine comes into the attack now.
Stays deep in the crease to the back of the length ball and blocks it nicely.
Short ball outside off, Afghan thinks about the pull but bails out at the last moment.
Fullish ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Well bowled! On a fuller length around off, Asghar leans ahead and tries to defend it but misses.
Rahmat works this one down the leg side. A single taken.
Driven through the covers by Shah.

Drinks taken! Ireland have completely dominated the proceedings till now. Tim Murtagh was in his elements as he nipped out three early wickets and did a lot of damage to the opposition. A run out has also taken place which is not good from the point of view of the visitors. The Afghanistan batsmen have been found wanting against some seam movement. The pair of Afghan and Shahidi needs to put up a good show if they are to come back into the contest.
On a length around off, kept out watchfully. A maiden from Rankin, good stuff.
In the channel outside off, Asghar lets it go.
A play and a miss! A length ball, Afghan tries to heave it away but gets beaten.
Some chin music for the batsman, as Rankin bangs this one in, but the Afghanistan skipper lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
A good length ball is pushed towards the covers.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
Back of a length, Shah works it to the leg side as the ball rolls down to the fielder at short fine leg. There is no chance of a run.
This length ball angling into the stumps is defended well by Shah off the front foot.
O'Brien strays on the pads, Afghan works it towards the square leg region for a single.
A short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. The batsmen run through for a single.
Shah shows the full face of the bat and defends this back of a length ball off the back foot.
Length ball on off is driven to mid off. No chance of a run.
Chase gets a bit straighter. Afghan walks inside the line and flicks it to the on side. They run two.
Wide! Too short this time as the bouncer goes well above the batsman's head. Wide signaled for height.
Bumper again, Afghan shows respect, ducks under it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
A fullish ball angling in on the pads, Afghan flicks this to the deep square leg region and gets two for it.
A bit short of a length, Afghan goes back and defends.
A very full delivery outside off, Afghan leans forward and drives it through the covers. The diving fielder at covers gets a hand to it but can't stop them from running a brace.
O'Brien pulls his length back, Shah rocks back and blocks it off.
Fuller this time on off, Shah comes forward and defends with a straight bat.
Length ball is defended off the front foot.
Length ball outside off stump, Shah gets forward and pushes at this one towards the point region, finds the gap and they pick up two more.
Lands it short of a length on off, Afghan opens the face of the bat and taps it towards the point fielder. They scamper through for a quick single.
A length ball landing in the line of off stump, moves away slightly on pitching, Afghan covers the away movement well and defends it off the front foot.
Kevin O'Brien to have a bowl now. The keeper is standing up to the stumps for him.
A fullish delivery on the stumps, Shah watchfully defends it off the front foot.
A back of a length ball on off, punched to the cover fielder.
Shah has done well to keep this very full ball out.

FOUR! Second boundary of the innings. Chase goes for the rib-tickler but Shah is up for it. He gets the pull out and plays it well over the square leg fielder. There is no one in the deep and the ball races across the ropes.
Shortish delivery just outside off, punched to the man at covers.
Length ball on the off stump, Shah gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.
What a ripper! Murtagh lands it in the corridor of uncertainty and the ball straightens after pitching. Asghar tries to block it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Full length ball around off, Afghan eases it to the cover region.
Fullish ball angling in, tucked to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Fullish ball around off, Rahmat comes forward and defends it nicely.
Well bowled! On a length, angling in. Shah is late to bring is bat down and is hit on the thigh pad.
Fuller in length around off, played with an angled bat towards the point region.
Good aggression from Chase! Bangs in a bouncer which angles in. Afghan sways away from the line to make a good leave.
Fuller in length, angling in, tucked with a closed bat face to mid-wicket.
Well played! Similar ball outside off, Shah hops and places it nicely past the slip cordon for a run.
Shortish ball around off, takes off. Rahmat rises on his toes and does well to block it.
Fullish ball outside off, Shah drives this one nicely but the cover fielder dives to his left to make a good stop.
Keeps this one marginally back of a length, the batsman blocks it off the back foot.
Length ball, played to the mid-wicket region for no run.
A straight ball is worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tight bowling by Murtagh as he lands it on a length on off. Shah defends it well.
Full length ball on off, driven to mid on.
The skipper, Asghar Afghan comes out to bat. A captain's knock is the need of the hour for him.

OUT! Afghanistan being generous, have gifted one to Ireland. Nothing to take away from Balbirnie though, that was a terrific effort. A short of a length ball on off is punched off the back foot towards covers by Shahidi. There is no run on offer but Hashmatullah calls for it and Shah responds. Andy in the same region charges in from his left, attacks the ball, dives and underarms a direct hit at the non-striker's end as the southpaw puts in a desperate dive. He seems to be struggling as the Irishmen are already ecstatic! It is referred to the third umpire. The replays show that Shahidi is well short of his crease. The visitors continue to slip.
The Irishmen are already celebrating. A brilliant piece of work from Balbirnie as he hits the bull's eye at the bowler's end. Seems like Shahidi is a goner.

Beaten! Chase lands this one on a length on the off stump, draws the batsman forward. The ball lands on the deck and moves away a bit. It misses the outside edge and Shah survives. Back-to-back maiden overs from Ireland. Terrific stuff.
Chase keeps it full and straight. Shah gets forward and keeps it out.
Gets back and across to this shortish delivery on off, taps it towards the point region. No run.
A shortish ball just outside off, Shah gets on his toes and punches this to the cover-point region. No chance of a single.
The batsman shoulders arms to this length ball outside off.
Misses out on that full toss. Chase bowls this one outside off, Shah drives it well but straight to the fielder at covers. A rare loose delivery missed.
Peter Chase comes into the attack.
Fullish ball on off, defended solidly off the front foot.

Edged but safe! The soft hands from Shahidi save him there. Full length ball on off, shaping away a touch. Shahidi comes forward and gets it off the outer half towards the slip cordon. Stirling at second slip comes forward but the ball lands just short of him.
Fractionally overpitched around off, driven sweetly but straight to the man at mid off.
Good length ball, leaving Shahidi. He makes a watchful leave.
On a similar line and length, seams away a bit after landing. The southpaw comes forward nicely and defends it down the track.
Fullish ball around off, Shahidi leans ahead and blocks it nicely.
Full ball on off stump, Shah leans forward and drives it to mid-off. No run.
A back of a length delivery is pushed towards the point region. No run on offer.
Lands it on a back of a length on off, Shah gets behind and defends.

Dropped! Should have been taken. Rankin bangs this one in short, Shah reads the length early, goes back, swivels and plays the pull but off the toe end. Simi Singh has to go down on his knees and react quickly at mid-wicket. He gets both hands on the ball but can't hold on. Will that turn out to be costly?
Shorter and wider of off, Shah leaves.
Rankin starts with a length ball outside off, shaping away. Shah shoulders arms.
Straighter and fuller ball, Shahidi drives this crisply but straight to mid on. No run.
A length ball outside off, left alone by Shahidi.
Length ball on the off stump, Shahidi comes forward and drives it to the right of mid off. The batsmen rush back for the second.
Wide. A bit short in length but the line is way wide of off. Shahidi leaves the ball for the umpire to signal a wide ball.
Length ball on off, defended off the front foot by Shahidi, presenting the full face of the bat.
Hashmatullah Shahidi is the new man in. Afghanistan are in a real crisis and he needs to put his hand up.

OUT! That's no. 3 for Murtagh. He is on fire. Bowls this delivery on a fuller length. Naib tries to work this one across the line but the ball seams in a bit after pitching, misses his bat and raps him dead in front of the wickets. A big appeal follows and the dreaded finger of the umpire goes up. Third blow to Afghanistan.
Marginally back of a length, shaping into the batsman, Naib stays back and works this towards mid-wicket.
A bit short and wide of the off stump, Rahmat lets this one go.
Shah gets forward and defends this fullish ball on the stumps.
Lands it on a length outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Short again, Naib pulls again but can't get the desired timing on it. The ball trickles behind square leg and they pick up a single.
Naib takes the short stuff on, sees the ball landing just behind a length. He swivels and pulls it towards the deep square leg region, the batsmen run two.
Short of a length outside off, Naib goes on the back foot and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Drives this fullish ball on off straight to mid off.
Straight ball on a length is driven to mid off.
A short of a length ball on the batsman's pads, Shah turns it towards the mid-wicket region and picks up two.
Murtagh gets a bit too straight and fires this one on his pads. Shah flicks this off his pads towards the deep square leg region. The batsmen cross over for a brace.
Length ball on off stump, Shah gets on the front foot and defends.
Rahmat Shah strides out to bat.

OUT! Afghanistan are in some early trouble! Both the openers are back in the hut and Murtagh is the man who is causing the damage. That's a big wicket for the home team and Zazai who was in brilliant form in the T20Is, departs cheaply again. Tim keeps it on a fuller length around middle and leg and the ball seams in after pitching. Zazai is cramped for room and there is not much foot movement from him. He is late on it as the ball misses his bat and crashes into the stumps. The Irish players are all smiles.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Lands it just short of a length outside the off stump, Naib stands tall, punches the ball in the gap between covers and point. The timing is good to take the ball racing across the fence. First boundary of the innings.
Length ball on off is defended off the front foot.
Beaten! He lands this one just outside off, the ball pitches and nips away, Naib tries to put bat to ball but it goes past the outside edge of his bat.
Naib shoulders arms to this back of a length delivery outside off.
Length ball on off, Gulbadin shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A short of a length ball angled in, Zazai walks inside the line of the ball and works it away to the leg side for a single.
Boyd Rankin to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Two slips in place for him as well.
Length ball angling in, Naib walks across a bit and turns it towards mid-wicket. No run. Brilliant start from Murtagh, a wicket and only a run from the first over.
Lands it short of a length outside off, Naib shoulders his arms.
Fullish ball on off is defended back to the bowler.
Naib covers the line of the ball and defends from within the crease.
Gulbadin Naib comes out to bat. He scored a gutsy fifty in the last game. Can he rise to the occasion again?

OUT! What a start for Ireland. Murtagh strikes in the very first over. Shahzad fails in his comeback game. Lands it on a fuller length on off. The ball hits the deck and nips back in slightly. Shahzad tries to flick it away but the inward movement beats the inside edge and hits his front pad. The hosts go up with a big appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Shahzad got tangled with his feet and fell over. Not what Afghanistan would have wanted.
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side, Mohammad tries to flick it but misses.
Starts off well with a good length ball shaping away. Shahzad gets right behind the line and blocks it.

We are about to get underway. The players and the umpires walk out to the middle. Mohammad Shahzad is back in the team and will open the batting with Hazratullah Zazai. Tim Murtagh will steam in with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that they would have liked to bat first as well. States that it was a good game for their bowlers in the first ODI. Reckons that it will be a similar track as the last one and they have to bat well.

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Afghan says that they will bat first. Mentions that they want to put a good score on the board. Feels that they have a good bowling attack and are backing themselves to defend. Informs there are two changes - Mohammad Shahzad and Najibullah Zardran come in for Ishanullah Janat and Shafiqullah Shafiq.
The Pitch Report is taking place. There is a little more green on the surface. The team winning the toss will prefer to bat as it will slow down as the game progresses.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 2nd ODI between Ireland and Afghanistan in Belfast. This is the home team's last chance to overhaul the mighty Afghans and come back in the series. Afghanistan, playing their 100th ODI, will be keen to continue their winning momentum and domination on Irish land. Even if the tourists had all their bases well covered in the last game, there is still some fine tuning to be done with regards to their batting. If the hosts' batsmen can apply themselves and come up with a clear plan to tackle the visiting spinners, we might be in for a good contest.
